notes.title: Release!
notes.notes: Two and a half years after quitting Visceral, and a bunch of hard work later, [i]A Case of Distrust[/i] is [b]finally[/b] available for purchase. I've been shaking uncontrollably all morning. This has been my dream. Thanks for joining me on this journey!
